description: Lists every Stablevoy store this server has a key for, all at once with no paging (usually one to a few). Needs a store key (npx stablevoy-mcp login). Each entry has id, name, status, enabledNetworks, canAcceptPayments, evmPayoutStatus, the payout addresses the store uses, whether each is its own or the account one, and the account addresses. Payout addresses are read only here. They change in the dashboard. A store whose key no longer works shows its error instead. An archived store has its keys revoked, so it shows that error. Call it first to learn the names for the store argument of the other tools. For the full settings of one store use get_store. A failure comes back as an error with its code and what to do, for example rate_limited with the seconds to wait.
name: list_stores
title: List connected stores
